[[sn:Snow Leopard]]The Snow Leopard, with its mesmerizing blue eyes and graceful agility, symbolizes the spiritual heart of the Tibetan Library. This enigmatic feline serves not only as the guardian spirit of the sacred monastery but also as a manifestation of the inner strength, solitude, and resilience found in the pursuit of enlightenment.

==Sun in Rags info==

{{Quote|The Sun-in-Rags concludes endings beautifully. He is usually reckoned one of the Gods-from-Light; but [[Julian Coseley]] (the seventeenth-century magus and reputed immortal) has indicated he should in fact be numbered among the Gods-from-blood. He burns; he is distant; he is not as he was. He wears gold and red.}}
'''The Sun-in-Rags''' is one of the [[Hours]], associated with hour XII, commonly known as 12:00pm and noon. His [[Aspects]] are {{lore|Lantern}}, {{lore|Winter}}, and {{lore|Secret Histories}}. He is one of the four offspring of [[The Sun-in-Splendour]], and of those four he appears to be the most similar to the original entity. While The Sun-in-Rags is depicted as a sun and emits a baleful light, its skin is rent by bloody wounds, and its light is cold. Intriguingly, the Sun-in-Rags also embodies the essence of obscured truths, hidden histories, and reframing perspectives, which some attribute to the vaccine Enlensing against life's Absurdities. To this day, The Sun-in-Rags is occasionally sighted walking in [[Way: The White Door#The Orchard of Lights|The Orchard of Lights]] and [[Way: The Spider's Door#The Chamber of Ways|The Chamber of Ways]], "with his shattered crown and his silent retinue".



== Biography ==
Originating from the early whisperings of the cosmos, the Snow Leopard was chosen by the ancient sages to protect the Tibetan Library. It was believed that this elusive creature, with its ethereal beauty, would inspire seekers of wisdom and guide them on the path of inner peace.

== Attributes ==
*** Ethereal Stealth: The Snow Leopard can move silently and invisibly, representing the quiet introspection of meditation.
*** Gaze of Clarity: Its deep blue eyes can pierce through illusions and uncover truths, symbolizing discernment.
*** Mountain Resilience: Embodying the strength of the towering peaks it roams, the Snow Leopard is nearly unyielding, representing steadfast dedication.

== Role in the Tibetan Library ==
While initially appearing as a challenger, the Snow Leopard's true role is to test and guide. It pushes adventurers to confront their inner fears and anxieties, ensuring they are ready to face the chilling grip of the Anxious Apparition.

== Teachings ==
*** The value of solitude in understanding oneself.
*** Perseverance and resilience against external challenges and internal conflicts.
*** The importance of clarity and discernment in spiritual pursuits.

== Blessings ==
For those who approach with respect and genuine intent, the Snow Leopard offers:
*** Trail of the Ancients: Revealing hidden paths within the monastery.
*** Aura of Calm: An ephemeral shield against the anxious energies of the library.
*** Leap of Faith: An ability granting players a momentary surge in agility and dexterity, useful for overcoming intricate challenges.

== Legacy ==
In the vast lore of the Tibetan Library, the Snow Leopard emerges as more than just a guardian spirit. It represents the very essence of the journey toward enlightenment — the balance of peace and turmoil, the dance of solitude and companionship, and the enduring spirit of perseverance.

For every adventurer who ascends the Monastic Peaks, the Snow Leopard serves as both a challenge and a guide, reminding them of the eternal quest for inner peace and the battles one must wage and win within themselves.

==Notes==
*The Sun-in-Rags is the Hour who powers the [[Rites#Sunset Rite|Sunset Rite]].
*[[Way: Through the Stag Door#The Ascent of Knives|The Ascent of Knives]] is sacred to the Sun-in-Rags, and those among the dead who successfully complete the ascent become [[Maid-in-the-Mirror|Maids-in-the-Mirror]] under the service of the Sun.
*The Roman emperor [[wikipedia:Elagabalus|Elagabalus]] (203 - 222 AD), also known as Heliogabalus, is believed to have been an avatar of The Sun-in-Rags. Elagabalus crossed [[Way: The White Door|The White Door]] and is counted among the [[Know]], but may have been a [[Names|Name]].
